# Greek Calculator Workspace

## Project Guidance
- Keep the app native to Android using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
- Preserve the retro calculator styling and the Greek keypad-to-arithmetic mapping.
- Run `./gradlew.bat testDebugUnitTest` for local tests and `./gradlew.bat assembleDebug` to build.
- Do not launch the app until the user confirms a debug run.
